entities.summary: Roman Empire, a political institution in Austria during Hallstatt Celtic Culture & Roman Noricum (15 BCE–476). Grew from Discovery of Hallstatt cemetery with over 1,000 burials. Led to the emergence of Roman Province of Noricum and Celtic Norican.
